verdict.rationale: Gemini Apps documents Workspace connectors (Gmail, Drive, Calendar) via 'Connected Apps' allowing search, summarization, event creation, and content management, plus Deep Research can pull sources from personal Gmail/Drive. This directly matches the story of connecting cloud drive, email, and calendar for use in answers. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the connector experience quality and reliability, and no mention of broader cloud drive support beyond Google Drive (e.g., third-party drives).
